messages.admin.demoNotice: Local demonstration. Switch identities to exercise independent review. Generated keys are for local development only.
messages.admin.overviewDescription: Manage endpoints, language resources and client behavior through reviewed, signed releases.
messages.admin.editorDescription: Edit runtime data within the installed trust policy. Deployment identity stays isolated.
messages.admin.reviewDescription: Review the diff, validate the complete snapshot and submit this exact content for approval.
messages.admin.hashBound: Approval binds to the saved content hash. Submitted drafts are frozen.
messages.admin.messagesDescription: Edit IDs and complete ICU patterns. User content never passes through replacement rules.
messages.admin.releasesDescription: Promote stable cohorts or create a reviewed rollback with a higher sequence.
messages.admin.auditDescription: Changes, approvals and pointer updates commit with resulting state in one transaction.
messages.admin.valid: Snapshot and language resources are valid
messages.admin.submitted: Submitted. This content is now frozen.
messages.admin.approved: Approval recorded for this content hash
messages.admin.attached: Language package attached. Save the draft to persist it.
messages.admin.needDraft: Create or open a draft first
messages.admin.noDiff: No snapshot changes from the installed baseline
messages.admin.previewOnly: Distribution preview. The client must still verify signature, identity, expiry and resource hashes.
messages.admin.portalDescription: Language and account region are independent. Changes use the same reviewed release; trusted account origins cannot move across regions.
messages.admin.portalDownloadsHelp: Array of platform, version, sha256 and url. Empty means unavailable; never reuse another region’s installer.
messages.admin.portalInvalidUrl: Use a public HTTPS URL without credentials, query or fragment.
messages.admin.portalApplied: Applied to draft. Save, review and publish to take effect.
